character.description: A friendly AI video company mascot for vidtory.ai, inspired by the Vidtory play-button logo and green-to-cyan brand gradient.
character.notes: Mascot should feel like a helpful AI video creator companion: playful, clever, production-ready, with a body silhouette subtly inspired by a play button and video frame. Preserve Vidtory brand colors: vivid lime green, mint green, turquoise/cyan, plus deep navy or white accents depending on background. Do not put readable brand text inside the character.

style_notes: clean modern 2D mascot, app-brand character design, rounded geometric shapes, crisp vector-like edges, strong silhouette, simple face, expressive eyes, premium SaaS/video-creation feel, not childish, not a generic robot

actions.notes: subtle breathing, blink, small play-button glow pulse
gesture as if presenting a generated video frame
friendly greeting through arm pose only
energetic production sprint motion without speed lines
